import sys
import bisect

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    a.sort()
    t = int(next(it))
    ans = -1
    for i in range(n):
        up = bisect.bisect_right(a, a[i] + t)
        if up - i > ans:
            ans = up - i
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
